You are assembling a clinical visit note. The sentences of one note are listed below in random order with their section headings removed. File every sentence under one of these four headings: SUBJECTIVE, OBJECTIVE EXAM, OBJECTIVE RESULTS, ASSESSMENT AND PLAN. In the JSON, the headings are the keys subjective, objective_exam, objective_results and assessment_and_plan. Return each sentence ID under exactly one heading. Do not leave any sentence out and do not invent IDs.

<sentences>
S1: The patient works from home and plans to coach his son’s basketball team in 04/2022.
S2: He experiences pain and feelings of instability within the ankle while ambulating and is concerned for further injury.
S3: Right lateral malleolar fracture.
S4: X-rays, including AP, lateral, and oblique views of the right ankle, were obtained in the office and reviewed today.
S5: SKIN: No epidermolysis.
S6: After reviewing the patient's examination and radiographic findings today, I have had a lengthy discussion with him regarding treatment options.
S7: Mild tenderness over the medial deltoid region.
S8: Jerry Cook is a 45-year-old male who presents today with a right ankle injury.
S9: Musculoskeletal: Reports right ankle pain and instability.
S10: Recommendation was made for an open reduction internal fixation of the right ankle.
S11: We discussed the risks and benefits of the procedure as well as the postoperative recovery period following surgery.
S12: I advised that it will be 3 months before he can resume his exercise routine.
S13: I recommended he ice and elevate the ankle as well.
S14: His pain is primarily located along the lateral aspect of the right ankle.
S15: Swelling on the lateral side of the ankle.
S16: In the meantime, I will prescribe meloxicam to reduce swelling.
S17: He reports he landed awkwardly and twisted his right ankle after jumping to make a layup.
S18: He will be given crutches to assist with ambulation.
S19: CV: Brisk capillary refill.
S20: There is no evidence of medial or posterior malleolar fractures.
S21: He notes bruising and swelling.
S22: The patient sustained an injury to the right ankle while playing basketball with his son.
S23: The patient understands and agrees with the recommended medical treatment plan.
S24: The patient is able to weight-bear while standing.
S25: He enjoys working out and reports he recently resumed engaging in a consistent gym routine.
S26: No horrible malalignment.
S27: Skin: Reports right ankle bruising and swelling.
S28: These demonstrate a displaced lateral malleolus at the Weber C level.
S29: MSK: Examination of the right ankle: Exquisite tenderness laterally.
